Title: Requires life preservers or similar throwable flotation devices to be kept at state-operated marinas, docks, and launches
Summary: Requires life preservers or similar throwable flotation devices to be kept at designated areas within state-operated marinas, docks, and launches.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the navigation law, in relation to requiring life preservers or similar throwable flotation devices to be kept at state-operated marinas, docks, and launches
